title: Patch Notes 1.19.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.19.0

Raiders,

Update 1.19.0 is now live. Restart your game to get the download.

* New cosmetics added:

* The Devotee Outfit Set.

* Two additional haircuts.

* Corrected a bug that showed the wrong sell value in the inventory when attached mods were selected.

* Corrected a bug that let the same item appear more than once in the sell and recycle popup window.

* Corrected a bug where a player's Coin balance could show an incorrect amount after selling items that had durability.

* Corrected a bug that let players place the Snaphook into the safe pocket by pressing Tab while using it.

* Corrected a bug that could trap players and ARC units in a doorway at the Auditorium location on Stella Montis.

* Corrected a bug that caused two interact prompts to show up for the Comet.

* Corrected an exploit involving the Zipline on Blue Gate.

* Corrected a bug where certain bodies of water on Dam Battlegrounds failed to freeze during the Cold Snap map condition.

* Corrected a bug that made Electromagnetic Storm lightning strike too often.

Server problems last week led some players to lose their loadouts even after extracting successfully. We are looking into these cases and will restore items where we can over the coming days. Compensation is not something we normally provide for every incident, but because this outage affected so many players, we are making an exception this time. Thank you for your patience while we worked through the issue.

See you topside,

Ossen
